mods.name: Oh My Teleport
mods.description: Teleport commands for singleplayer and Fabric servers: /back after death, request-based /tpa with /tpaccept, /home and /sethome, and personal /warp points.

releases.notes:
Teleport commands for **Minecraft 26.3** on Fabric. Works in singleplayer and on Fabric servers.

Requires **Fabric Loader 0.20.0+** and **Fabric API**. Java 25.

## Features

- `/back` — return to your death point, then to your pre-teleport position
- `/tpa` + `/tpaccept` — request-based teleporting between players, 60-second expiry
- `/home` + `/sethome` — per-player named homes
- `/warp` — personal named teleport points
- No OP required; cross-mod dimension support with no extra config

## Install

1. Install Fabric Loader 0.20.0+ and Fabric API.
2. Drop the jar into your `mods/` folder.

In singleplayer, enable cheats to use commands.

See the [README](https://github.com/D3nesyan/oh_my_teleport#readme) for commands and behaviour details, or the [中文说明](https://github.com/D3nesyan/oh_my_teleport/blob/main/README.zh_cn.md).
